errors.auth_expired: The connection expired. Reconnect to keep syncing.
errors.auth_revoked: Access was revoked on the platform. Reconnect.
errors.permission_denied: The connected account lacks the required permissions.
errors.rate_limited: The platform is limiting requests; it will retry automatically.
errors.not_configured: The platform isn't configured on the server.
errors.invalid_phone: The number can't receive WhatsApp messages.
errors.not_opted_in: The recipient hasn't agreed to WhatsApp messages.

callbackErrors.oauth_state: The connection request expired or couldn't be verified. Start again.
callbackErrors.oauth_denied: Access was declined on the platform.
callbackErrors.oauth_failed: The connection didn't complete. Try again.
callbackErrors.forbidden: You don't have permission to manage integrations.

whatsappConnect.title: Connect WhatsApp Business
whatsappConnect.description: Create a system user in Meta Business settings with the whatsapp_business_messaging permission, then paste its details here. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
whatsappConnect.accessTokenHint: A permanent system-user token, not a temporary one.

detail.name: Name
detail.disconnectBody: The access token is deleted for good and syncing and lead intake stop. Numbers already synced and the history stay.
detail.reconnectHint: Nothing syncs and no leads arrive until you reconnect.
detail.noAccountsBody: The platform returned no accounts for this connection. Check the permissions, then refresh.
detail.mapFirst: Map an ad account to a client first
detail.mapFirstBody: On the Accounts tab pick the client for each ad account, then link the platform's campaigns to that client's campaign channels here.
detail.noChannels: This client has no campaign channel for this platform. Add a channel to a campaign first.
detail.noPlatformCampaigns: No campaigns on the platform for this account.
detail.noTemplatesBody: Create and approve templates in WhatsApp Manager, then refresh.
detail.notificationTemplateHint: The notification template needs two variables: '{{1}}' for the title and '{{2}}' for the text and link. One template per language.

accountHints.ad_account: Syncs its linked campaigns' numbers daily.
accountHints.page: Receives leads from this page's lead ad forms.
accountHints.whatsapp_number: Notifications and messages are sent from it.
accountHints.analytics_property: Available for upcoming reports; its numbers are not synced in this phase.

sync.queued: Sync added to the log and starting now.
sync.backfillBody: Pull daily numbers for a past period (up to {days} days). Days already synced are replaced, never duplicated.
sync.explain: Syncs run daily for the last {days} days so numbers the platforms restate later are corrected. Linked channels take their numbers from the platform.
sync.result: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · {campaigns, plural, one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}
sync.emptyBody: Map accounts and campaigns, then press “Sync now”.

urlHint.meta: Register it in your Meta app → Webhooks → Page (field leadgen) with the META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN verify token.
urlHint.whatsapp: Register it in your Meta app → WhatsApp → Configuration (field messages) with the same verify token.
urlHint.tiktok: Register it in your TikTok for Business app for lead form notifications.
urlHint.snapchat: Register it in Snap Business Manager for lead form notifications, with SNAPCHAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
urlHint.google: Paste it into the Google Ads lead form with the GOOGLE_LEAD_WEBHOOK_KEY key.

reasons.unknown_account: No connected account has this id.
reasons.inbound_messages_not_supported: Inbound messages aren't shown in this phase.
reasons.lead_without_contact: The lead has no phone or email.

webhooks.emptyBody: Platform notifications (leads and message statuses) appear here once their signature is verified.

panel.title: WhatsApp
panel.noPhone: This record has no mobile number.
panel.noTemplates: No approved templates. Ask an integrations admin to connect WhatsApp Business.
panel.dialogBody: It goes to <phone></phone> from the agency's number, using an approved template.
